none: PAS WMID-A50857: Roman Coin: Denarius of Elagabulus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete (about 85% of the coin survives) silver denarius of Elagabulus dating to the period AD 218-222 (Reece Period 10). LIBERALITAS AV[G __]II (possibly III or IIII at end of reverse legend). Reverse depicts Liberalitas draped, holding abacus and cornucopiae. Mint of Rome. Obverse shows a laureate, draped bust right. Obverse legend: [IM]P ANTONINVS PIVS AVG. See RIC IV, part 2, page 35,…
